performance_case.causal_mechanism: A fixed, hash-bound completed-day shock anatomy can distinguish repeatable continuation, reversal or risk-clustering evidence from retrospective news stories while reusing the sole clock and already accepted canonical OHLCV chain.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task can prove only schema, deterministic construction, idempotent sealing, same-heartbeat Coach delivery and offline tests. It cannot prove a real deployment, causal why, prediction, sample sufficiency, fees, slippage, PnL, drawdown, candidate readiness, OOS or Trading value.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. Only a later separately frozen equal-capital experiment could test whether a point-in-time post-shock state avoids adverse paths without excessive missed gains; this slice creates no strategy rule.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: A four-file deterministic child is cheaper and less biased than a daily LLM/news workflow. Failing closed on insufficient future shocks is preferable to mining nearby thresholds, extending the R1 window or reopening closed volatility exits.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Immediate fee-adjusted total PnL is unchanged. The source slice can reduce learning latency by automatically sealing a comparable forward diagnostic whenever the already accepted BTC UTC day moves at least 3%, before any later factor or outcome is selected.
